title: THIRA Project — Kyushu University & Grameen Communications
excerpt: Serving as Assistant Coordinator and Data Collector for the THIRA project with Kyushu University and Grameen Communications.
author: Fazley Rabbi
cover_alt: Official group photograph with faculty and research team members for the THIRA project collaboration.
body:
## International Research Collaboration

Between **August 2024 and August 2025**, I had the privilege of contributing to the **THIRA Project (Travel Health Impact Research Application)** — a joint research initiative between **Kyushu University, Japan** and **Grameen Communications, Bangladesh**.

The project investigates travel health parameters and leverages digital health technologies to understand and mitigate health impacts during travel and daily commutes.

## Roles & Responsibilities

In this project, I was recognized for serving as **Assistant Coordinator** and **Data Collector**:

- **Data Collection & Field Operations**: Collected real-world health and environmental data, coordinated participant onboarding, and ensured data integrity across field surveys.
- **Coordination & Communication**: Bridged communication between local field teams, academic researchers, and organizational stakeholders at Grameen Communications and Kyushu University.
- **Data Processing & Technical Documentation**: Assisted with data curation, preprocessing datasets, and maintaining documentation for research analysis and reporting.

## Learning & Impact

Working on an international research project provided invaluable hands-on experience in research methodology, healthcare data processing, and multidisciplinary collaboration. Collaborating with esteemed faculty members and dedicated research peers broadened my perspective on using technology for real-world social impact.

These photographs capture official meetings at the Department of Accounting & Information Systems, team coordination sessions, field activities, and moments at Grameen Communications.
